## Quality review

- [ ] Responsibilities and dependency direction match the architecture docs.
- [ ] New abstractions represent a real variation or infrastructure boundary.
- [ ] Interfaces are narrow and implementations preserve documented contracts.
- [ ] Scalability claims have measurements, thresholds, or an operational reason.
- [ ] Tests are at the lowest useful layer; browser coverage is limited to critical journeys.
- [ ] Formatting, lint, typecheck, affected tests, and relevant builds pass.
- [ ] Relevant E2E, accessibility, and visual gates pass without hidden retries.
- [ ] Architecture, API, design, security, or runbook docs were updated if needed.
